basics.description: Deploy the **frontier models on public cloud** reference: an AI Gateway in front of Microsoft Foundry models, with Application Insights traces. You get access automatically; callers sign in with Microsoft Entra ID.

location.label: Resource group region
location.toolTip: Region of the resource group itself. Resources use the Deployment region below.

basics.name: region
basics.label: Deployment region
basics.toolTip: AI Gateway is in preview in these regions. Foundry, monitoring and agent resources use the same region.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix for resource names. A unique suffix is added.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3 to 8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter.

options.text: Each selected model gets a Global Standard deployment in Foundry. Gateway models are callable by name, and gpt-latest fails over from gpt-6.1-sol to gpt-6-sol. Check your Global Standard quota for each model in the selected region.

allowedValues.label: gpt-6.1-sol
allowedValues.description: OpenAI. Newest flagship; first choice for gpt-latest. Through AI Gateway.

allowedValues.label: gpt-6-sol
allowedValues.description: OpenAI. Previous flagship; failover for gpt-latest. Through AI Gateway.

allowedValues.label: gpt-6-luna
allowedValues.description: OpenAI. GPT-6 family model. Through AI Gateway.

allowedValues.label: gpt-6-astra
allowedValues.description: OpenAI. GPT-6 family model. Through AI Gateway.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft-Decision-1 (preview)
allowedValues.description: Microsoft decision model, deployed as decision-1. Foundry endpoint only; AI Gateway does not route decision models yet.

elements.name: capacity
elements.label: Capacity per model
elements.toolTip: Global Standard capacity for each selected model. Lower it if your quota is short.

options.text: You (the account running this deployment) get the AI Gateway User role automatically, so you can call models with an Entra token. Every gateway also has a built-in master API key for quick tests; the deployment outputs show how to read it. Optionally grant one more user, group or service principal. To find an object ID, run: az ad user show --id <email> --query id -o tsv

elements.name: principalId
elements.label: Additional object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Entra object ID of another user, group or service principal to grant the AI Gateway User role and Foundry access.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an object ID (GUID) or leave it empty.

options.text: Every call is traced to Application Insights. Payload capture adds token usage and the serving model to traces, and stores request and response text.

elements.name: payloadCapture
elements.label: Capture request and response payloads in traces (needed for token usage and model in traces; stores prompt and completion text)

elements.name: reportStatus
elements.label: Report deployment status to the Sovereign AI site, so it can follow this deployment and open its next steps (sends tenant, subscription, resource group and deployment names, your Entra object ID and the next-steps links)
